verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a REST API, an official Go SDK, and remote and local MCP servers, but never mentions an official command-line tool. The locally run Node.js component (riveter-docs-10) is an MCP connection option, not a CLI, so it earns no credit here. A data-enrichment SaaS could plausibly ship a CLI, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
